approval.record: Phillip Wikes has not approved, amended or rejected these criteria. Results are reported against them as unapproved proposals.

interpretation: Meeting every criterion would support continuing to a small, separately authorized live study. It would not support any validation, reliability, accuracy, production or release claim. Every rate is agreement with an AI-authored or LLM-reproduced reference.
scope_of_rates: Evaluation partition (synthetic families F05 to F10, 60 records) unless the metric says otherwise. Family clusters are reported with every rate.
predictions_basis: Predictions come from development-partition runs (dev-5, vdev-3) and from the known limitations KL-01 to KL-08, all recorded before the freeze.
